statusDetail: Coverage-complete model audit across desktop and mobile home templates plus schedule, voting, beginner guide, recovery, and 404 archetypes.

page.framework: Server-rendered Java/JSP-style MPA with jQuery/Bootstrap and separate /pc and /sp templates
page.notes: Root redirects to /pc/top for the evidence CLI; Lighthouse mobile emulation audited /sp/top. Public Japanese official keirin information and wagering entry point.

artifacts.caption: Scripts, modern CSS, focus, targets, and semantic probe
robots, sitemap, and HTTP status evidence

checkOutcomes.method: Screenshot and computed-style probe under prefers-color-scheme: dark
checkOutcomes.evidence: The dark-condition screenshot remains a light interface; colorScheme is normal, body is rgb(245,244,242), and no prefers-color-scheme rule was found.

checkOutcomes.method: getAnimations and stylesheet probe under prefers-reduced-motion: reduce
checkOutcomes.evidence: The reduce preference matched and no active Web Animations or CSS reduced-motion-relevant animations were present after load.

checkOutcomes.method: Forced-colors and prefers-contrast probe plus screenshot
checkOutcomes.evidence: Under forced-colors: active, text and controls resolve to system black/white colors with visible borders; the screenshot remains operable.
Navigation between the homepage, schedule, voting list, guide, and recovery pages is an abrupt full-document swap; no view-transition CSS was found.
The audited templates contain no parallax, scrollytelling, or scroll-linked reveal effect to implement.
checkOutcomes.reason: The audited templates contain no parallax, scrollytelling, or scroll-linked reveal effect to implement.

checkOutcomes.evidence: The tested pages use ordinary native scrolling and taps and expose no custom pointer-driven gesture that fights platform behavior.
The long homepage and schedule retain static chrome with no scroll-state query, progress cue, or conditional scroll affordance.
No tooltip, popover, or tethered menu was present on the audited templates.
checkOutcomes.reason: No tooltip, popover, or tethered menu was present on the audited templates.

checkOutcomes.method: Screenshots of home, schedule, voting, recovery and error paths
checkOutcomes.evidence: Breadcrumbs, selected day tabs, section headings, and the 404 top-page action visibly preserve orientation and direct the next step.

checkOutcomes.method: Load screenshots on five representative paths
checkOutcomes.evidence: No full-screen interstitial, consent wall, or load-time overlay obscured content on any captured path.

checkOutcomes.method: DOM primitive and overlay element probe
checkOutcomes.evidence: No transient overlay or disclosure control was present on the audited paths.
checkOutcomes.reason: No transient overlay or disclosure control was present on the audited paths.

checkOutcomes.evidence: The homepage devotes substantial space to repeated race chrome, sidebars, ticker copy, dense banners, borders, and tiny link lists, crowding the core schedule and voting actions.

checkOutcomes.method: 360x800 screenshot, layout metrics, and mobile-page probe
checkOutcomes.evidence: The desktop route has no viewport meta and renders as a 1263 CSS-pixel page scaled to 0.285; the dedicated mobile route disables zoom with user-scalable=0.

checkOutcomes.method: CSS feature probe and PC/mobile route comparison
checkOutcomes.evidence: No @container/container-type rules were found; separate /pc and /sp templates are shipped instead of reusable components adapting to available space.
The first focused control computes outline-style none, and visible controls as small as 18px high were measured, below robust touch-target sizing.
Current races immediately expose LIVE and 投票 actions, while the schedule, voting list, beginner guide, and recovery page each state their purpose.

checkOutcomes.method: Navigation walkthrough across schedule, voting list, guide, and account recovery
checkOutcomes.evidence: Representative public tasks are reachable with real links, schedule browsing exposes venue detail links, and recovery presents three explicit account-recovery branches.
Unavailable race actions are visibly disabled; a real 404 response shows a clear Japanese explanation and a top-page recovery button.
Lighthouse measured LCP 5.2s and CLS 0.301; the independent trace measured LCP/FCP 3.65s. These miss good CWV thresholds.

checkOutcomes.method: Lighthouse CLS audit and image audit
checkOutcomes.evidence: Lighthouse measured CLS 0.301 and 98 of 100 desktop images lacked explicit dimensions, leaving widespread late-layout risk.

checkOutcomes.method: Trace long-task summary and Lighthouse TBT
checkOutcomes.evidence: The trace recorded zero long tasks and 0ms TBT; Lighthouse also measured 0ms total blocking time.

checkOutcomes.method: HAR summary confirmed against live script attributes
checkOutcomes.evidence: The load transfers 3.0MB in 133 requests; nine parser-inserted stylesheets and many synchronous non-defer head scripts precede content, and large text resources are uncompressed.
Lighthouse estimates 189KiB unused JS and 208KiB unused CSS, including 97% unused Bootstrap CSS; the HAR includes jQuery 1.11.3 and jQuery UI.

checkOutcomes.method: Lighthouse accessibility audit and DOM probe
checkOutcomes.evidence: The page has missing alt attributes (Lighthouse examples and 72 DOM images without alt) and unlabeled search/login/recovery inputs.
Lighthouse found multiple failures, including cyan tab text at 2.83:1 and disabled LIVE text near 1.5:1.

checkOutcomes.method: Lighthouse landmarks audit and focus probe
checkOutcomes.evidence: There is no h1 or main landmark, and the programmatically focused first control has no visible outline.
The desktop layout is highly dense; at 360px it is scaled down wholesale, making body links and status text extremely small and difficult to scan.

checkOutcomes.method: Mobile viewport audit, screenshot, and target probe
checkOutcomes.evidence: The /sp viewport sets maximum-scale=1 and user-scalable=0, while the PC route scales a desktop canvas; several controls are only 18-22px high.
Lighthouse reported no browser console errors during load.

checkOutcomes.method: Lighthouse document audits and image primitive
checkOutcomes.evidence: Doctype, charset and aspect ratio pass, but 98/100 images lack dimensions, 91 use legacy formats, and 77 below-fold images are not lazy-loaded.

checkOutcomes.method: Lighthouse BFCache diagnostics and script inventory
checkOutcomes.evidence: The mobile page is not BFCache eligible due to an unload handler and no-store responses, and ships legacy jQuery 1.11.3.
The title and descriptive meta description are present in both rendered and raw HTML.

checkOutcomes.method: Lighthouse SEO, robots.txt, DOM links, and mobile route
checkOutcomes.evidence: Lighthouse reports crawlable anchors and valid robots.txt; representative navigation uses real hrefs and a dedicated mobile route exists.

checkOutcomes.method: HTTP, robots/sitemap, and DOM metadata inspection
checkOutcomes.evidence: Public pages return 200 and allowlisted robots paths, but no canonical was exposed and /sitemap.xml redirects to the homepage instead of serving a sitemap.
The sports/event homepage exposes zero JSON-LD blocks and zero Open Graph tags, so race/event entities and social previews lack structured metadata.
HTTPS and nosniff/X-Frame-Options are present and no cookies were set, but CSP and HSTS are missing.

checkOutcomes.method: HAR, trackers, cookies, and secrets primitives
checkOutcomes.evidence: All 133 observed requests were first-party; no known trackers, cookies, or exposed secrets were detected.

checkOutcomes.method: Mobile script/auth probe and login form inspection
checkOutcomes.evidence: No load-time permission request was found, but the relevant account login exposes password-only authentication and no WebAuthn/passkey capability was detected.
X-Frame-Options and nosniff are present, but HSTS, CSP, Referrer-Policy, and Permissions-Policy are all absent.

checkOutcomes.method: Raw-HTML discoverability comparison and crawler screenshot
checkOutcomes.evidence: Only 33% of rendered content words are present in raw HTML; substantial race content is lost without JavaScript even though the page is not an empty shell.
The MPA routes loaded without runtime errors; no edge-clipped overlay exists and breadcrumb/top-page recovery preserves navigation context.
Installability/offline transaction support is not expected for a live wagering and current-race service that intrinsically depends on real-time server state.
checkOutcomes.reason: Installability/offline transaction support is not expected for a live wagering and current-race service that intrinsically depends on real-time server state.

checkOutcomes.evidence: A missing route returns HTTP 404 and presents a readable Japanese error with a prominent top-page recovery action.

checkOutcomes.method: DOM language and visual reading-order probe
checkOutcomes.evidence: html lang is correctly ja and the Japanese left-to-right reading order is consistent across representative templates.
Dates, month/day labels, years, and race times are consistently rendered in conventions appropriate to the declared Japanese locale.
All audited event times refer to domestic Japanese velodromes in a single national time zone; no cross-zone or DST-sensitive workflow was present.

checkOutcomes.method: Home, voting, guide, recovery, and error screenshots
checkOutcomes.evidence: No consent nag, disguised advertisement, confirmshaming, forced continuity, or preselected commercial option appeared; age and purchase-limit links are prominent.
Recovery inputs have no programmatic labels or required attributes and expose no semantic validation state, undermining timely, accessible error recovery.

checkOutcomes.method: Login and recovery form DOM probes
checkOutcomes.evidence: Login has autocomplete off for the password and recovery fields have empty autocomplete values, preventing appropriate autofill assistance.
The site prominently states the 20+ restriction and purchase-limit setting, and provides visible password recovery and account help before transaction entry.
The homepage downloads 96 images/1.44MB; 91 of 100 DOM images use PNG/JPEG/GIF, 77 below-fold images are eager, and responsive sources are largely absent.
The page eagerly fetches 133 resources and ships hundreds of KiB of unused CSS/JS, including multiple old UI libraries, despite zero measured main-thread need.

checkOutcomes.method: HAR resource budget and tracker probe
checkOutcomes.evidence: Third-party cost is zero, but total first-party transfer is still 3.0MB with 96 images, disproportionate to a schedule-and-links first viewport.
No declared agent-facing intent exists; this public information/wagering site does not currently expose a safe agent transaction surface, so absence is an opportunity rather than a failure.
checkOutcomes.reason: No declared agent-facing intent exists; this public information/wagering site does not currently expose a safe agent transaction surface, so absence is an opportunity rather than a failure.

checkOutcomes.evidence: No summarisation, translation, or generative workflow requiring on-device inference was identified on the audited paths.
checkOutcomes.reason: No summarisation, translation, or generative workflow requiring on-device inference was identified on the audited paths.

checkOutcomes.evidence: After ten bottom/top scroll cycles, the independently loaded post snapshot was 10.60MB/157,411 nodes versus baseline 10.50MB/155,557 nodes; the small bounded delta gives no evidence of runaway growth.
The loaded homepage heap is approximately 10.5MB with 155,557 nodes, proportionate to this dense but finite document.
The compact before/after heap summaries show no growing Detached* constructor population or order-of-magnitude node growth after repeated scrolling.

principleOutcomes.reason: No declared agent-facing intent exists; this public information/wagering site does not currently expose a safe agent transaction surface, so absence is an opportunity rather than a failure. No summarisation, translation, or generative workflow requiring on-device inference was identified on the audited paths.

paths.description: Desktop homepage: primary current-race, live-viewing, voting, login, navigation, and content-density template.
Dedicated /sp homepage: mobile form factor, mobile accessibility, and content-equivalence template.
Representative data-dense listing/calendar and venue-navigation template.
Primary commercial entry listing showing available race/voting choices.
Representative editorial/help content archetype for prospective members.
Sensitive account-recovery form archetype and input-assistance flow.
Intentional missing route used to assess HTTP and user recovery behavior.

findings.summary: Add preference-driven dark theme
findings.evidence: The dark-condition screenshot remains a light interface; colorScheme is normal, body is rgb(245,244,242), and no prefers-color-scheme rule was found.
findings.suggestedFix: Add preference-driven dark theme. Follow Modern Web Guidance “dark-mode”, preserve existing Japanese content and transaction safeguards, and verify under the same captured condition.

findings.summary: Make route changes preserve spatial continuity
findings.evidence: Navigation between the homepage, schedule, voting list, guide, and recovery pages is an abrupt full-document swap; no view-transition CSS was found.
findings.suggestedFix: Make route changes preserve spatial continuity. Follow Modern Web Guidance “cross-document-transitions”, preserve existing Japanese content and transaction safeguards, and verify under the same captured condition.

findings.summary: Add useful scroll-state navigation cues
findings.evidence: The long homepage and schedule retain static chrome with no scroll-state query, progress cue, or conditional scroll affordance.
findings.suggestedFix: Add useful scroll-state navigation cues. Follow Modern Web Guidance “scroll-position-aware-elements”, preserve existing Japanese content and transaction safeguards, and verify under the same captured condition.

findings.summary: Refocus the homepage on current races and primary actions
findings.evidence: The homepage devotes substantial space to repeated race chrome, sidebars, ticker copy, dense banners, borders, and tiny link lists, crowding the core schedule and voting actions.
findings.suggestedFix: Refocus the homepage on current races and primary actions. Follow Modern Web Guidance “css-layout”, preserve existing Japanese content and transaction safeguards, and verify under the same captured condition.

findings.summary: Replace scaled desktop rendering and restore zoom
findings.evidence: The desktop route has no viewport meta and renders as a 1263 CSS-pixel page scaled to 0.285; the dedicated mobile route disables zoom with user-scalable=0.
findings.suggestedFix: Replace scaled desktop rendering and restore zoom. Follow Modern Web Guidance “css-layout”, preserve existing Japanese content and transaction safeguards, and verify under the same captured condition.

findings.summary: Consolidate PC/mobile templates around adaptive components
findings.evidence: No @container/container-type rules were found; separate /pc and /sp templates are shipped instead of reusable components adapting to available space.
findings.suggestedFix: Consolidate PC/mobile templates around adaptive components. Follow Modern Web Guidance “size-aware-styling”, preserve existing Japanese content and transaction safeguards, and verify under the same captured condition.

findings.summary: Restore visible focus and enlarge small targets
findings.evidence: The first focused control computes outline-style none, and visible controls as small as 18px high were measured, below robust touch-target sizing.
findings.suggestedFix: Restore visible focus and enlarge small targets. Follow Modern Web Guidance “accessibility”, preserve existing Japanese content and transaction safeguards, and verify under the same captured condition.

findings.summary: Bring LCP and CLS into good ranges
findings.evidence: Lighthouse measured LCP 5.2s and CLS 0.301; the independent trace measured LCP/FCP 3.65s. These miss good CWV thresholds.
findings.suggestedFix: Bring LCP and CLS into good ranges. Follow Modern Web Guidance “performance”, preserve existing Japanese content and transaction safeguards, and verify under the same captured condition.

findings.summary: Reserve image and dynamic-content space

findings.suggestedFix: Reserve image and dynamic-content space. Follow Modern Web Guidance “performance”, preserve existing Japanese content and transaction safeguards, and verify under the same captured condition.

findings.summary: Shorten the critical chain and compress resources

findings.suggestedFix: Shorten the critical chain and compress resources. Follow Modern Web Guidance “performance”, preserve existing Japanese content and transaction safeguards, and verify under the same captured condition.
